verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly market Pydantic AI as model-agnostic with 'every model a string swap away' and built-in support for many providers (OpenAI-compatible APIs, Bedrock, Gemini, Groq, etc.), and a maintainer confirms broad streaming/provider support across OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, Gemini, Groq, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepSeek, Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter and more. Some community reports note provider-specific quirks (streaming inconsistencies, structured-output reliability) that add friction but don't contradict the core provider-swap capability.
